assessment.nobel_worthiness: A highly distinctive Romanian-language voice. His densely patterned, visionary prose turns memory, the body and dream into a metaphysical project of unusual ambition. Public knowledge of Blinding and Solenoid points to formal daring and imaginative depth that stand out against the longlist. The case rests on the whole body of prose and poetry, not on one celebrated work.
assessment.attribution: The citation would cover a single author whose work joins poetry, the long visionary novel and an internally coherent personal mythology. It could be framed around the imaginative reinvention of the novel through memory and the body. That is a literary claim, not a claim about national symbolism.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a clearly developed, recurring imaginative world, and later works that extend its scale rather than repeat it. Sustained quality looks strong on public knowledge, though I cannot verify it independently.
uncertainties: Translation carries much of the evidence, and the density and rhythm of the Romanian prose may be only partly conveyed.
Coverage of the poetry and shorter prose is thinner than coverage of the large novels.
Length and encyclopedic excess may be a strength or a weakness depending on the reader.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A precise, unsettling French-language voice. Narratives of exclusion, family power and unstable belonging are carried by controlled prose with an uncanny undertone. Three Strong Women and My Heart Hemmed In show formal control and psychological depth. Her work in drama broadens the range.
assessment.attribution: A clear single-author citation is possible: the estrangement of social and domestic worlds rendered with an unmistakably personal narrative method. Her fiction and drama can both be named within a single claim.
assessment.maturity: She began publishing young and has maintained a consistent, evolving body of work for decades. The oeuvre is substantial and its quality appears steady, though it is more compact than some other candidates'.
uncertainties: I cannot independently verify the full range of her later work or her drama.
Translated texts may flatten the register shifts that define her French.
Her oeuvre is smaller in scale than the largest on the list, which affects judgements of breadth.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences such as Purgatory and Anteparadise turn suffering and historical violence into collective memorial form. Poetry that extends into landscape-scale work is unusual and offers a distinctive voice with real moral and formal weight. This is the strongest poetry case in my ranking.
assessment.attribution: The citation would concern a single poet whose Spanish-language work joins personal and national catastrophe with a rewritten visionary tradition. The landscape interventions are a risk to scope: the citation should rest on the poetry as literature.
assessment.maturity: Decades of work, with a consistent project and sustained development. Durability looks high given how deeply the work is tied to modern Latin American poetic and historical memory.
uncertainties: Poetry translates unevenly, and the committee's reading of the originals may differ from the English renderings I am aware of.
How far the landscape and visual pieces bear on literary merit is a matter of judgement.
Strong ties to a specific historical moment may shape how the work is read.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Encyclopedic fiction that connects systems of power, scientific knowledge and countercultural imagination. Gravity's Rainbow and Mason & Dixon are demanding works of enormous linguistic range, comic invention and structural ambition, with an unmistakable voice. His influence on the late-twentieth-century novel is widely acknowledged.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation would concern the encyclopedic, paranoid-comic novel as a vehicle for thinking about systems and history. Authorship is not in doubt.
assessment.maturity: A long career with major works across several decades. Some later novels are judged less consistently than the peak works.
uncertainties: Opinion differs on the later novels, so sustained quality across the whole oeuvre is not settled.
The idealistic orientation required by Nobel's will is not easy to establish from this work.
Fame and canonical status must not stand in for evidence of merit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A transformative figure in Arabic poetry who recast poetic language through myth, fragmentation and a sustained dialogue with inherited forms. Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses show formal achievement and intellectual depth. His critical essays on tradition reinforce the poetic project.
assessment.attribution: A single-poet citation is clear: the renewal of Arabic poetic language and its relation to tradition. The essays are part of the same project and can be named in the citation.
assessment.maturity: An extremely long career with a body of work that has shaped a generation of poets. Durability is established. Late work may add less than the early and middle periods.
uncertainties: The achievement lies in the Arabic language, and translations convey it only partly.
I cannot independently judge the relative strength of his late poetry.
His essayistic and cultural positions are discussed alongside the poetry, and the committee should keep literary merit distinct from them.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Grotesque and mythic narrative forms expose the violence of ideology and development. The Four Books and The Explosion Chronicles show a willingness to break realist conventions and a strongly individual voice. The distinctive element is a literary strategy of exaggeration and invented narrative systems, not simple political reportage.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation can centre on the invention of an unmistakable mode of Chinese fiction for treating collective history. It should rest on formal invention, not on censorship or political symbolism.
assessment.maturity: A substantial and still developing body of work over several decades. Consistency varies, and the strongest works appear to be later ones.
uncertainties: Translation uncertainty is considerable, because the language games are hard to carry across.
The political context of his publication history can crowd out the literary assessment.
I cannot verify the quality of the many works not named here.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dense, compressed prose that turns obscure lives and art history into a powerful narrative inquiry. Small Lives and The Eleven show an unusual French style with a strong sense of language and fate. It is a rigorous, concentrated achievement of voice.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation can name the invention of a condensed, high-register prose form for the lives of the obscure and the artist. The scope is narrow but unmistakable.
assessment.maturity: A compact oeuvre of consistently high quality. Depth is considerable, but the small scale limits the comparison with larger bodies of work and may limit the scope of a citation.
uncertainties: The syntax and register are very hard to translate, so translation-based assessment is uncertain.
The oeuvre is short, and sustained achievement across a body of work is more modest than for others.
Its reach beyond a French literary readership is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Linguistic invention brings oral storytelling into novels of war, memory and postcolonial life. Sleepwalking Land and Confession of the Lioness show a distinctive Portuguese shaped by Mozambican speech and neologism, with real imaginative and humane depth. He is a strong example of how a literary language can be enlarged from within.
assessment.attribution: A single-author citation can name the renewal of Portuguese through Mozambican oral tradition in fiction, with poetry as a secondary strand.
assessment.maturity: A long, productive career with a recognizable approach. Some of the later work may repeat established strategies, so consistency of invention across the full oeuvre needs checking.
uncertainties: His invented vocabulary and wordplay are among the hardest features to translate, so the foreign-language evidence may understate or distort the effect.
I cannot verify the balance of strength across his many novels and stories.
The place of his poetry within the oeuvre is less clear to me.
